g.text: Occupancy (share of the 4 ligands of the set, written on the line):
Stroke weight and opacity follow occupancy, the share of the 4 ligands of the set in which a contact is made, in three
steps (90 % and more, 50 to 90 %, less than 50 %); the share is written on the line, or under the name of a residue
